title: Russia's offensive ability is broken, Kyiv's former top general tells BBC
english: Ukraine's former commander-in-chief, Oleksandr Syrskyi, stated that the country has successfully halted Russian progress by inflicting significant casualties on their forces. In his first interview since leaving office, he claimed that the death rate for Russian troops is substantially higher than that of Ukrainian soldiers. Syrskyi attributed the current battlefield deadlock to this disparity in losses, combined with Ukraine's improved defensive strategies and technological developments.
amharic: የዩክሬን የቀድሞ የጦር አዛዥ ኦሌክሳንደር ሲርስኪ እንዳሉት ዩክሬን በሩሲያ ኃይሎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት በማድረስ የሩሲያን ወታደራዊ እድገት ማቆም ችላለች። ከሥልጣናቸው ከተነሱ በኋላ በሰጡት የመጀመሪያ ቃለ መጠይቅ፣ የሩሲያ ወታደሮች የሟቾች ቁጥር ከዩክሬን ወታደሮች ጋር ሲነጻጸር እጅግ የላቀ መሆኑን ተናግረዋል። አሁን ያለው የጦር ግንባር መቆም ለዚህ የጉዳት ልዩነት እንዲሁም ለዩክሬን የተሻሻለ የመከላከያ ስልቶች እና የቴክኖሎጂ አቅም እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ajajaan waraanaa duraanii kan Yukreen Oleksander Sirskiy akka jedhanitti, Yukreen humnoota Raashiyaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisuun dursanii fuuldura deemuu isaanii dhaabsiisuu dandeesseetti. Aangoorraa erga kaafamanii booda gaafii fi deebii jalqabaa irratti, baay'inni waraana Raashiyaa du'an kan Yukreen caalaa akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Amma waraanni iddoo tokkotti dhaabachuu isaa fi humni Raashiyaa dadhabachuu isaa kan ibsan, kana kan ta'eefis miidhaa guddina waraana Yukreen fi jijjiirama tekinoolojii irratti hundaa'uun akka ta'e himaniiru.

title: One dead and several hurt after rollercoaster incident at Six Flags
english: A tragic accident occurred at the Six Flags Over Georgia amusement park, resulting in the death of one person and injuries to several others on a rollercoaster. Local police are currently investigating the circumstances, though official details regarding how the incident happened remain limited. Reports from witnesses suggest a rider fell from the attraction, and park officials are cooperating fully with the ongoing investigation.
amharic: በጆርጂያ በሚገኝ ሲክስ ፍላግስ መዝናኛ ፓርክ በተከሰተ አሳዛኝ የሮለር ኮስተር አደጋ አንድ ሰው ህይወቱ አልፏል፤ ሌሎች በርካቶችም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የአካባቢው ፖሊስ በአሁኑ ወቅት ጉዳዩን እያጣራ ቢሆንም፣ አደጋው እንዴት እንደተከሰተ የሚገልጽ ዝርዝር መረጃ እስካሁን አልወጣም። የአይን እማኞች ግለሰቡ ከመቀመጫው ወድቆ እንደነበር የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ የፓርኩ አስተዳደርም ምርመራውን እያገዘ እንደሚገኝ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Paarkii bashannanaa Six Flags kan garaa Joorjiyaatti argamu keessatti balaa suukanneessaa mudateen namni tokko lubbuun isaa yeroo darbu, kanneen biroon immoo miidhaniiru. Poolisiin naannichaa haala balaan itti mudate qorachaa jiruus, odeeffannoon guutun hanga ammaatti ifa hin taane. Namoonni balaa kana argan akka jedhanitti, namichi konkolaataa bashannanaa irraa kufuusaa ibsaniiru; bulchiinsi paarkichaa immoo qorannicha keessatti gahee isaa baachaa jiraachuu beeksiseera.

title: US emergency call records reveal confusion after failed execution of Christa Pike
english: Recently released emergency call records reveal significant confusion among Tennessee prison officials following a failed lethal injection execution of convicted murderer Christa Pike. The internal miscommunication caused delays in medical care after the two doses of drugs administered failed to end her life. Pike is currently back in prison after recovering from the incident, creating an unprecedented legal situation as she is believed to be the only person to survive such an execution attempt.
amharic: በቅርቡ ይፋ የተደረጉ የድንገተኛ አደጋ ጥሪ መዝገቦች በቴነሲ ግዛት የተፈረደባት ገዳይ ክሪስታ ፓይክ ላይ የተሞከረው የሞት ቅጣት መክሸፉን ተከትሎ በእስር ቤት ኃላፊዎች መካከል የነበረውን ግራ መጋባት ያሳያሉ። የተሰጡት የሟች መርዞች ውጤት ባለማምጣታቸው ምክንያት የተፈጠረው የመግባባት ችግር ለታካሚዋ ህክምና መዘግየት ምክንያት ሆኗል። ክሪስታ ፓይክ ከኢንሲደንቱ ካገገመች በኋላ ወደ እስር ቤት የተመለሰች ሲሆን፣ በሟች መርዝ የመገደል ሙከራ በህይወት የተረፈች ብቸኛ ሰው እንደሆነች ይታመናል።
oromo: Galmeen waamicha hatattamaa dhiheenya ifoome akka agarsiisutti, ajjeechaa Kristaa Paayik irratti godhame erga kashamee booda hoggantoota mana hidhaa Teenesii gidduutti wal-dhabdeen uumamee ture. Kennaan summii du'aa inni lachuu waan hin milkoofneef, wal-dhabdee keessoo kana irraa kan ka'e yaalii fayyaa irratti tursiisuun uumameera. Kristaa Paayik dhukkubaa ishee irraa erga fayyitee booda ammas mana hidhaatti kan deebite yoo ta'u, yaalii ajjeechaa akkanaa du'aa kan oolte nama jalqabaa waan taateef, seenaa seeraa keessatti haala adda ta'e uumteetti.

title: Israel’s military raids NGO offices in Ramallah
english: Israeli military forces conducted raids on several non-governmental organization offices located in Ramallah within the occupied West Bank. Among the targeted groups were a human rights association and a women's committee, while soldiers also entered the grounds of a public hospital. These actions have drawn attention to the ongoing tension and the military's reach into civil society institutions in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ ራምላህ በሚገኙ በርካታ መንግሥታዊ ያልሆኑ ድርጅቶች ቢሮዎች ላይ ወረራ ፈጽመዋል። ከተጎዱት ተቋማት መካከል የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች እና የሴቶች ኮሚቴዎች የሚገኙበት ሲሆን ወታደሮቹ የመንግሥት ሆስፒታል ቅጥር ግቢንም ወረው ነበር። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በክልሉ ውስጥ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ውጥረት እና ወታደራዊ ኃይሉ በሲቪል ተቋማት ላይ እያደረሰ ያለውን ተጽዕኖ ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el kutaa West Bank kan ta'e magaalaa Ramallah keessatti waajjiraalee dhaabbilee miti-m mootummaa hedduu irratti duula gaggeessaniiru. Dhaabbilee miidhaman keessaa gareewwan mirga namoomaa fi komiitii dubartootaa kan argaman yoo ta'u, waraanni kun dirree hospitaala mootummaa keessattis seenanii turan. Gochi kun naannichatti walitti bu'iinsa jiruufi dhiibbaa waraanni dhaabbilee hawaasaa irratti godhu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: A look at the country’s local, regional and global initiatives
english: A recent feature from Al Jazeera explores Qatar's dedicated efforts to support individuals with autism. The program examines various projects being implemented by the country on a local, regional, and international scale. These initiatives aim to improve awareness, inclusion, and resources for the autistic community.
amharic: አልጀዚራ በቅርቡ ባቀረበው ዘገባ ኳታር ኦቲዝም ላለባቸው ግለሰቦች ድጋፍ ለማድረግ የምታደርገውን ጥረት ዳስሷል። ፕሮግራሙ አገሪቱ በአገር ውስጥ፣ በክልል ደረጃ እና በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ እየተገበለች ያለችውን የተለያዩ ፕሮጀክቶች ይፈትሻል። እነዚህ ተነሳሽነቶች ኦቲዝም ላለባቸው ሰዎች ግንዛቤን፣ ተሳትፎን እና ድጋፍ ሰጪ ግብዓቶችን ለማሻሻል ያለሙ ናቸው።
oromo: Al-Jazeeran gabaasa dhiyeenya kana dhiyeesseen, biyyi Qatar namoota qaama miidhamtoota autismii (autism) qaban gargaaruuf carraaqqii taasisaa jirtu xiyyeeffannoo keessa galcheera. Sagantaan kun, biyyattiin sadarkaa biyyaalessatti, naannootti fi addunyaatti pirojektiiwwan garaagaraa hojiirra oolchaa jirtu qorata. Hojiiwwan kunis, hawaasa autismii qabanuf hubannoo, hirmaannaa fi carraa gargaarsa hawaasummaa guddisuuf kan kaayyeeffatanidha.

title: Trump Protester punched at Trump rally as they’re mocked by the president
english: During a political rally in Youngstown, Ohio, a protester was physically assaulted by supporters of Donald Trump. The individual, who wore a shirt demanding the release of Epstein-related documents, was also ridiculed by the former president as security personnel escorted them from the venue. This incident highlights the volatile atmosphere often present at these public campaign events.
amharic: በኦሃዮ ያንግስታውን በተካሄደ የፖለቲካ ሰልፍ ላይ አንድ ተቃዋሚ በዶናልድ ትራምፕ ደጋፊዎች ላይ አካላዊ ጥቃት ደርሶበታል። የኤፕስታይን ፋይሎች ይፋ እንዲደረጉ የሚጠይቅ ቲሸርት ለብሶ የነበረው ግለሰብ፣ የፀጥታ አስከባሪዎች ከስፍራው በሚያስወጡት ወቅት በትራምፕ ሲዘበትበት ታይቷል። ይህ ክስተት በምርጫ ቅስቀሳዎች ላይ የሚከሰተውን ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Youngstown, Ohio keessatti walgahii siyaasaa Donald Trump irratti namni tokko kan mormii qabu deggertoota isaatiin reebameera. Namichi kun kan mormii qabu kun uffata waa'ee galmee Epstein ilaalchisuun dubbatu kan uffate yoo ta'u, yeroo humnoonni nageenyaa isa bakka sanaa baasanis Donald Trump isatti qoosaniiru. Gochi kun walgahiiwwan siyaasaa gurguddoo irratti mudatuu kan danda'u wal-dhabdee fi miira cimaa agarsiisa.

title: Activist Greta Thunberg joins French student protests
english: Climate activist Greta Thunberg has joined French students in Saint-Denis as they protest against poor educational conditions, including staff shortages and overcrowded classrooms. The movement, which involves hundreds of schools nationwide, is calling for greater inclusion in political decision-making and better school infrastructure. Recent demonstrations have faced significant tension, with students reporting concerns over police treatment while teachers and union members show their support through organized marches.
amharic: የአየር ንብረት ተሟጋቿ ግሬታ ተንበርግ በፈረንሳይ በትምህርት ተቋማት ውስጥ ያሉ የከፋ ሁኔታዎችን እና የመምህራን እጥረትን በመቃወም ላይ ካሉ ተማሪዎች ጋር ተቀላቅላለች። በመላ አገሪቱ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ትምህርት ቤቶችን ያሳተፈው ይህ የተማሪዎች እንቅስቃሴ ለትምህርት ቤት መሠረተ ልማት ማሻሻያ እና በፖለቲካ ውሳኔዎች ላይ ተሳትፎ እንዲኖራቸው እየጠየቀ ነው። ሰልፎቹ በፖሊስ የኃይል እርምጃ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ውጥረት ውስጥ የገቡ ሲሆን፣ መምህራን እና የሠራተኛ ማህበራት ተማሪዎችን በመደገፍ ሰላማዊ ሰልፎችን እያካሄዱ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Duudhaa jijjiirama qilleensaa Gireetaa Tunbeerg barattoota Faransaay mana barumsaa isaanii keessatti haala mijaataa dhabuu fi hanqina barsiisotaa mormaa jiran cinaa dhaabbatteetti. Sochii biyyoolessa kana keessatti manneen barnootaa dhibbootaan lakkaawaman hirmaachaa jiran yoo ta'u, bu'uuraalee barnootaa fooyyessuu fi dhimma isaanii irratti dhaggeeffatamuu gaafachaa jiru. Hiriirri kun humna poolisii irratti kan xiyyeeffate ta'uu isaa fi sodaa dararaa poolisii qaban ilaalchisee barattoonni komachaa jiran; gama biraatiin immoo barsiisonni fi gamtaaleen hojjattootaa hiriira kana deeggaraa jiru.

title: One killed, several injured in Georgia rollercoaster ‘incident’
english: A fatal accident occurred on a rollercoaster at a Six Flags amusement park in Georgia, resulting in one death and multiple injuries. Following the incident, the company temporarily shut down nine similar rides across several locations as a safety precaution. Local authorities are currently investigating the circumstances surrounding the event to determine exactly how the tragedy took place.
amharic: በጆርጂያ በሚገኝ ሲክስ ፍላግስ መዝናኛ ፓርክ በተከሰተ የሮለር ኮስተር አደጋ አንድ ሰው ሲሞት ሌሎች በርካቶች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ኩባንያው ለደህንነት ሲባል በተለያዩ ቅርንጫፎቹ የሚገኙ ዘጠኝ ተመሳሳይ መጫወቻዎችን በጊዜያዊነት ዘግቷል። የአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት የአደጋውን መንስኤ ለማጣራት ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Buufata bashannanaa 'Six Flags' kan naannoo Joorjiyaa keessatti, makiinaa taphaa 'rollercoaster' iratti balaa tasaa mudateen namni tokko lubbuun isaa darbee kanneen biroo irratti miidhaan ga’eera. Kompaaniin kun balaa kana hordofee, of eeggannoo duraa fudhachuuf jechuudha, makiinoota wal-fakkaatan sagal paarkota isaanii gara garaa keessatti yeroof cufaniiru. Abbootiin taayitaa naannichaa haala balaan kun itti mudate irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Saudi Arabia refuses request from Netanyahu to join fight against Houthis, says report
english: Saudi Arabia has turned down a proposal from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to collaborate in military actions against Houthi forces in Yemen. Netanyahu had hoped this cooperation would improve diplomatic relations between the two nations through American mediation. However, the Saudi leadership rejected the offer due to concerns about potential public disapproval, and ongoing regional tensions have further stalled progress toward normalizing ties.

title: Hunger strike in Lebanese prisons ends after settlement over amnesty bill reached
english: Prisoners in Lebanon have ended a 30-day hunger strike following an agreement regarding a long-delayed general amnesty bill. This legislation was initially paused due to legal challenges, but a constitutional ruling has now allowed it to proceed with specific revisions. The law is intended to address severe overcrowding in facilities like Roumieh prison, where thousands of detainees have faced prolonged periods without trials.

title: Egypt links its national security to Gulf security after GCC talks
english: Egyptian Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty recently met with the head of the Gulf Cooperation Council to discuss regional stability. During the talks, he emphasized that Egypt views the safety and security of Gulf nations as inseparable from its own national interests. He further pledged Egypt's continued support and solidarity with Saudi Arabia.

title: Saudi Arabia refuses request from Netanyahu to join fight against Houthis, says report
english: Saudi Arabia has rejected an Israeli proposal to cooperate in military operations against Houthi forces in Yemen. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu sought this partnership to improve diplomatic relations, but Saudi leadership declined due to concerns about potential public disapproval. Meanwhile, Iran has urged Saudi Arabia to seek a peaceful, diplomatic resolution to the ongoing conflict rather than escalating military action.

title: Trump insists energy ceasefire holds as Ukraine reports new Russian strikes
english: President Donald Trump claims that Russia and Ukraine have agreed to stop attacking each other’s energy infrastructure to help de-escalate the conflict. However, Ukraine reports that Russia has already violated this purported truce by striking multiple energy facilities since the announcement. Trump continues to urge both leaders to end the war, despite skepticism from officials and ongoing military activity on the ground.

title: Russia and Ukraine trade strikes amid doubt over ‘energy ceasefire’
english: Despite claims by Donald Trump regarding an 'energy ceasefire,' Russia and Ukraine are continuing to exchange military strikes. President Zelenskyy confirmed that Russian attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure remain ongoing. Neither government in Moscow or Kyiv has officially verified that a ceasefire agreement actually exists.

title: Cyberattack on French supermarkets causes fires, millions in losses
english: A major cyberattack targeted refrigeration systems at French supermarkets, causing temperatures to rise drastically to 50 degrees Celsius. This manipulation resulted in store fires and the forced disposal of massive amounts of spoiled food. The incident has caused significant financial losses and led to empty store shelves across the country.

title: ‘Unprecedented’ cyberattack hits French supermarkets, causing food losses
english: A massive cyberattack recently targeted the refrigeration systems of hundreds of French supermarkets, causing temperatures to rise and destroying large quantities of food. The hack, which forced remote defrosting, also triggered fires in several retail locations across the country. French authorities have launched an investigation into the incident, which retailers estimate could result in tens of millions of euros in damages.

title: Ethiopia’s Tigray war: Where do the UAE and Saudi Arabia stand?
english: The renewed conflict in Ethiopia's Tigray region has drawn attention to the differing roles of the UAE and Saudi Arabia in the Horn of Africa. The UAE has openly declared its support for the Ethiopian federal government while advocating for peace, driven in part by its significant commercial interests in the region's trade infrastructure. Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia is being examined for its potential as a diplomatic mediator, building on its previous efforts to resolve regional disputes. Both nations remain key external players as the stability of the 2022 peace agreement becomes increasingly fragile.
amharic: በኢትዮጵያ የትግራይ ክልል ዳግም የተከሰተው ግጭት በተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬቶች እና በሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ የአፍሪካ ቀንድ የፖለቲካ ሚና ላይ ትኩረት እንዲሰጥ አድርጓል። የተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬቶች በክልሉ ካላት የንግድ ፍላጎት በመነሳት የኢትዮጵያን መንግስት በግልፅ እንደምትደግፍ ገልጻለች። በሌላ በኩል ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ ቀደም ሲል በነበሩ የሰላም ጥረቶች መሰረት በግጭቱ ውስጥ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ሚና ሊኖራት እንደሚችል እየታየ ነው። የሁለቱ የባህረ ሰላጤ ሀገራት አቋም የ2022 የሰላም ስምምነት አደጋ ላይ በወደቀበት በአሁኑ ወቅት የክልሉን ሁኔታ ለመረዳት ወሳኝ ሆኗል።
oromo: Gonkootni naannoo Tigraayitti deebi'ee ka'e, gahee biyyoota Galaana-Garaa kanneen akka UAE fi Sa'udii Arabiyaa kan Afrikaa Gaanfa keessatti qaban irratti xiyyeeffannoo uumeera. UAE faayidaa daldalaa naannichatti qabduun walqabatee, mootummaa federaalaa Itoophiyaa akka deggeritu ifatti ibsiteetti. Gama biraatiin, Sa'udiin Arabiyaa carraaqqii nageenyaa kanaan dura taasisteen kan ka'e, akka giddu-galaatti (mediator) gahee taphachuu dandeessuun ishee tilmaama keessa galeera. Walii galtee nageenyaa bara 2022 akkuma rakkoo keessa galeen, matattii biyyoota kunneenii haala naannichaa irratti dhiibbaa guddaa qaba.

title: IRGC official warns against foreign powers interfering in Hormuz Strait
english: The head of Iran's Revolutionary Guard has issued a stern warning to international forces regarding the Strait of Hormuz. He stated that outside nations lack the authority to exert control or threaten the security of this vital waterway. According to the commander, the region must remain free from foreign dominance or intervention.
amharic: የኢራን አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ አዛዥ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ላይ የውጭ ኃይሎች ጣልቃ እንዳይገቡ ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥተዋል። በውጭ አገር የሚገኙ ኃይሎች በዚህ ስልታዊ የባህር መስመር ላይ ምንም አይነት ቁጥጥር ወይም ስጋት የመፍጠር መብት እንደሌላቸው ተናግረዋል። በአጠቃላይ ክልሉ ከማንኛውም የውጭ ጣልቃ ገብነት ነጻ መሆን እንዳለበትም አፅንዖት ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Ajajaan waraana Eegduu Warraaqsaa Iraan, humnootiin alaa daandii bishaan Hormuz keessa akka hin seenne akeekkachiisa dabarsaniiru. Biyyoonni alaa daandii bishaan kana irratti dhiibbaa gochuuf ykn sodaa uumuuf mirga akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Akka isaanii, naannichi dhiibbaa fi giddu-galummaa humnoota alaa irraa bilisa ta'uu qaba jedhaniiru.

title: Immigration agents raid home of Congresswoman Ilhan Omar, Trump calls her 'totally crooked'
english: Federal agents recently searched Congresswoman Ilhan Omar’s Washington, D.C. residence as part of an investigation into alleged immigration fraud. President Donald Trump publicly criticized the lawmaker following the operation, though he stated he had no direct role in the Department of Justice's activities. The raid was confirmed by officials as an ongoing federal inquiry involving multiple government agencies.

oromo: Hojjettoonni mootummaa federaalaa mana jireenyaa miseensa kongiraas Ilhaan Omar kan Washingitan Diisii keessa jiru, shakkii yakka seera godaantotaa dabsuun qorachuu isaanii gabaafameera. Pirezidaanti Doolaald Tiraamp tarkaanfii kana booda miseensa kongiraasittii irratti yaada qeequu kan kennan yoo ta'u, qorannoo kana keessatti harka akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Ministirri haqaa qorannoo kana gaggeessaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, qaamoleen mootummaa qorannichi ammayyuu itti fufaa akka jiru mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Trump says US midterm elections will not impact approach to war on Iran
english: President Donald Trump has stated that the upcoming United States midterm elections will not change his strategy regarding Iran. He emphasized that his current approach toward the conflict remains unaffected by domestic voting results. Additionally, he expressed optimism that the situation will conclude quickly, predicting a significant decrease in global oil prices once the issue is resolved.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቅርቡ የሚካሄደው የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ በኢራን ላይ ያላቸውን አቋም እንደማይቀይር ገልጸዋል። የአገር ውስጥ ምርጫ ውጤቶች በፖሊሲያቸው ላይ ምንም አይነት ተጽእኖ እንደማይኖራቸው አስታውቀዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ ግጭቱ በቅርቡ እንደሚጠናቀቅ ያላቸውን እምነት በመግለጽ፣ ይህ ሲሆን የነዳጅ ዋጋ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እንደሚቀንስ ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Amerikaa Donald Traamp filannoon biyyattii gara fuulduraatti gaggeeffamu tooftaa isaan Iran irratti qaban akka hin jijjiirre ibsaniiru. Bu'aan filannoo biyya keessaa adeemsa isaanii irratti dhiibbaa akka hin qabaanne mirkaneessaniiru. Kana malees, waraanni kun dafee akka xumuramu abdi qabaachuun, xumura isaa booda gatiin boba'aa addunyaa gadi bu'uu isaa dubbataniiru.

title: Riyadh rocked by explosions as Iranian strikes in Hormuz rise
english: The Houthi group in Yemen launched a series of missile strikes targeting Riyadh's airport and a military base in Saudi Arabia, resulting in multiple explosions. Simultaneously, tensions in the region have escalated as Iran's Revolutionary Guard reportedly attacked a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz. These incidents highlight a significant expansion of conflict that threatens both regional stability and Saudi Arabia's economic plans.
amharic: የየመን ሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሪያድ አየር ማረፊያ እና በሳውዲ አረቢያ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ላይ ሚሳይሎችን በመተኮስ ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታዎችን አስከትለዋል። በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ፣ የአይራን አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ ውስጥ በነዳጅ መጫኛ መርከብ ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸሙ ቀጠናዊ ውጥረትን አባብሶታል። እነዚህ ተያያዥ ክስተቶች የየመንን ጦርነት ከማስፋፋታቸውም በላይ ለሳውዲ አረቢያ የኢኮኖሚ ግቦች እና ለቀጠናው ሰላም ትልቅ ስጋት ፈጥረዋል።
oromo: Garee Hutiin Yaman kanneen jedhaman dirree xiyyaara Riyaadii fi buufata waraana Sa’udii Arabiyaa irratti weerara mishaayilii raawwataniiru. Yeroo wal fakkaatuuttis, waraanni Iran kanneen jiran Hormuz keessatti markaba boba’aa fe’u irratti haleellaa raawwachuun isaanii naannichatti muddama uumeera. Hojiileen kun waraana Yaman bal’isuu qofa osoo hin taane, nageenya naannichaa fi karoorawwan dinagdee Sa’udii Arabiyaa irratti balaa cimaa uumaniiru.

title: Etihad and Qatar Airways suspend flights to Saudi cities
english: Etihad Airways and Qatar Airways have paused flight services to several Saudi Arabian cities due to ongoing regional instability. This decision follows recent attacks by Houthi forces targeting Saudi airports, which have created safety concerns. While some suspensions are temporary, Etihad has specifically confirmed that flights to Riyadh will remain grounded until October 19th.

oromo: ጂቲሃድ ኤርዌይስ (Etihad Airways) fi Qatar Airways naannichatti rakkoo nageenyaa uumameen walqabatee gara magaalota Sa’udii Arabiyaatti balaliinsa godhan dhaabanii jiru. Murtoon kun kan dhufe erga gareen Huutii buufataalee xiyyaaraa Sa’udii irratti haleellaa raawwatee booda dha. Etihad balaliinsa gara Riyaad jiru hanga Sadaasa 19tti akka dhaabu beeksisuun isaa ni yaadatama.

title: Why Moscow is staying tight-lipped on Trump's energy ceasefire
english: President Donald Trump recently announced an immediate ceasefire regarding strikes on energy infrastructure between Russia and Ukraine, though both nations have reacted with uncertainty. While the Kremlin has avoided making an official statement, state-aligned media suggests Moscow views the proposal as a strategic advantage that favors their interests over Ukraine's. The deal appears intended to stop Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian oil facilities, which have recently caused significant economic damage and fuel shortages within Russia.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በሩሲያ እና በዩክሬን መካከል በሃይል ማመንጫ ተቋማት ላይ የሚደረጉ ጥቃቶችን የሚያቆም የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት መደረሱን በቅርቡ አስታውቀዋል። የሩሲያ መንግስት በይፋ አስተያየት ከመስጠት ቢቆጠብም፣ የመንግስት ሚዲያዎች ይህ ስምምነት ለሩሲያ የላቀ ጥቅም ያለው እና የዩክሬንን እጅ የሚያስር እንደሆነ እየገለጹ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ በተለይ በሩሲያ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎች ላይ በዩክሬን ድሮኖች የሚሰነዘሩ ጥቃቶችን ለማስቆም ያለመ ሲሆን፣ እነዚህ ጥቃቶች በሩሲያ ኢኮኖሚ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እያደረሱ ቆይተዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doolnaald Traamp ergaa dhiheenya darbe biyyoota Raashiyaa fi Yukreen gidduutti dhaabbata humna ibsaa irratti haleellaan akka hin geggeeffamne waliigaltee ta'e jedhanii labsaniru. Mootummaan Raashiyaa hanga ammaatti ibsa ifaa kenna baatuus, miidiyaaleen biyyattii waliigalteen kun Yukreen haleellaa akka hin raawwanne kan ishee daangessuu fi Raashiyaaf carraa gaarii kan uumu ta'uu ibsaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun haala addaa kanaan haleellaa doroonii Yukreen buufataalee qulqulleessa boba'aa Raashiyaa irratti geggeeffamu dhaabuuf kan karoorfame yoo ta'u, haleellaan kun dinagdee Raashiyaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisaa ture.

title: Breaking Bad actor RJ Mitte dies aged 34
english: RJ Mitte, the actor recognized for his portrayal of Walter White Jr. in the hit series Breaking Bad, has passed away in Texas at the age of 34. Beyond his acting career, he was a dedicated advocate for disability awareness and inclusivity, using his platform to support philanthropic organizations. His cause of death has not yet been disclosed by his representatives.
amharic: በታዋቂው የቴሌቪዥን ድራማ 'ብሬኪንግ ባድ' ላይ ዋልተር ዋይት ጁኒየርን በመጫወት የሚታወቀው አርጄ ሚቴ በ34 ዓመቱ በቴክሳስ አረፈ። ከትወና ስራው በተጨማሪ፣ ለአካል ጉዳተኞች መብትና ተሳትፎ ትልቅ ድጋፍ ሲያደርግ የነበረ ታዋቂ ሰው ነበር። የሞቱበት ትክክለኛ ምክንያት እስካሁን በይፋ አልተገለጸም።
oromo: Aartistii beekamaa fi qophii 'Breaking Bad' keessatti Walter White Jr. ta'ee kan beekamu RJ Mitte, umurii 34tti biyya Texasitti du'eera. Inni tapha fiilmii qofa osoo hin taane, mirga namoota qaama miidhamtootaaf falmuu fi gargaarsa namoomaa irratti gumaacha guddaa godha ture. Sababni du'a isaa hanga ammaatti ifatti hin himamne.

title: US archbishop says Catholics in army should not participate in firing squad
english: Archbishop Timothy Broglio has called on Catholic members of the U.S. military to refuse participation in the upcoming execution of Nidal Hasan by firing squad, citing church opposition to capital punishment. This comes after Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced plans to livestream the execution of the 2009 Fort Hood shooter to serve as a deterrent. Religious leaders and critics are speaking out against the plan, labeling it a barbaric public spectacle that could be exploited for extremist propaganda.

title: Poland says two Turks arrested over Russia-linked Starlink station fire
english: Two Turkish nationals were arrested in Germany on suspicion of setting fire to a Starlink internet station in Poland. Polish authorities believe this act was organized sabotage carried out on behalf of Russian intelligence to disrupt military communications in Ukraine. This incident is considered part of a broader campaign of hybrid attacks by Russia within the European Union.

title: Why the Cornell gang rape case has raised concerns about fraternity culture
english: Cornell University recently closed its Chi Phi fraternity chapter following a serious lawsuit accusing its members of participating in a gang rape. This incident has reignited national concerns regarding the dangers of Greek life culture, which critics argue uses exclusivity to hide violence and abusive initiation rituals. Experts suggest that while these organizations promise brotherhood, their practices sometimes foster environments where misconduct is normalized.

oromo: Yuunivarsiitiin Koorneel garee barattootaa 'Chi Phi' jedhamu kan miseensonni isaa gudeeddaa gareedhaan raawwataniiru jedhamee himataman cufuun isaa beekameera. Mudannoon kun aadaa garee barattootaa kanneen 'Greek life' jedhamanii waamaman keessatti gochi suukanneessaan fi miidhaan akkamitti akka haguugamu irratti marii guddaa kaaseera. Hayyoonni akka ibsanitti, garee kanneen keessatti walitti dhufeenyi obbolummaa jedhamee gabaabbatu, yeroo baay'ee gochaa seeraan alaa fi hammeenya keessummeessuuf carraa uuma.

title: Canada’s Carney calls for unity as Alberta prepares for secession vote
english: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney has urged citizens to remain united ahead of an upcoming non-binding referendum in Alberta regarding potential secession from the country. The push for independence is driven by regional dissatisfaction with federal environmental and energy policies affecting the oil and gas sector. This vote comes at a tense time as the country also navigates recent political shifts in Quebec and reported international interest in Alberta's political future.

title: Six Ukrainian energy sites hit by Russia since Trump announced ceasefire, Zelensky says
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky reported that Russia launched attacks on six energy facilities shortly after US President Donald Trump announced an energy ceasefire. Despite Trump's claim of an immediate truce, these strikes resulted in power outages, infrastructure damage, and multiple injuries across various Ukrainian regions. Zelensky described the ongoing aggression as a clear rejection by Russia of the proposed ceasefire agreement.

title: Saudi minister vows 'serious response' to Houthi attacks on airports
english: Saudi Arabia’s energy minister has promised a significant retaliation following a series of deadly Houthi missile and drone attacks targeting the nation's airports and energy infrastructure. These strikes have resulted in multiple civilian casualties and caused major damage to aviation facilities across several cities. The Houthis claim these actions are a direct response to Saudi-led military operations within Yemen.

title: Immigration agents search Congresswoman Ilhan Omar's home
english: Federal immigration agents recently conducted a court-authorized search of Representative Ilhan Omar's home in Washington, DC, as part of an active criminal investigation. Representative Omar has denounced the raid, characterizing it as a politically motivated act of intimidation by the current administration.

title: Blast kills teenager, injures dozens in northern Israel
english: A 15-year-old student tragically died and about 20 others were injured after an unexploded piece of military ammunition went off during a school outing in northern Israel. The explosion occurred in a region currently experiencing border tensions, leading the military to launch an investigation. Authorities are working to determine if the device originated from Israeli forces or the militant group Hezbollah.

title: Pope Leo continues working after lung surgery announcement
english: Pope Leo has decided to carry on with his regular duties despite the news that he requires a surgical procedure on his lung. The upcoming operation was scheduled after a medical examination revealed a minor growth in his lung. He remains active in his role while preparing for the medical intervention later this week.

oromo: Paappaasii Liyoon yeroo dhiyootti baqaqsanii hattuuf garaa garoo (opiraashinii) sombaatiif qophaa'aa jiranillee hojii isaanii idilee itti fufanii jiru. Opiraashinichi kan murtaa'e erga qorannoon fayyaa somba isaanii irratti dhibee xiqqoo tokko agarsiisee booda. Innis opiraashinii dhuma torban kanaa keessa taasifamuuf of qopheessaa hojii isaa gaggeeffachaa jira.

title: UK PM Andy Burnham vows to renegotiate post-Brexit trade deal with EU
english: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham has announced plans to renegotiate the country's post-Brexit trade agreement with the European Union to strengthen economic ties and address issues like immigration. During a parliamentary address, he emphasized that the government aims to reduce trade barriers for food exports and establish a new youth exchange program. While he believes this pragmatic approach will improve the economy, political opposition leaders have expressed skepticism regarding his ability to secure a better deal.
amharic: የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም ከብሬክዚት በኋላ ከነበረው የአውሮፓ ህብረት የንግድ ስምምነት ጋር የተያያዙ ጉዳዮችን እንደገና ለመደራደር ማቀዳቸውን አስታውቀዋል። የሀገሪቱን ኢኮኖሚ ለማነቃቃት እና የኢሚግሬሽን ጉዳዮችን ለመፍታት ያለመው ይህ ውጥን፣ የምግብ ምርት ንግድ እንቅፋቶችን መቀነስ እና የወጣቶች ልውውጥ ፕሮግራም መመስረትን ያካትታል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ይህ አካሄድ በኢኮኖሚው ላይ የደረሰውን ጉዳት እንደሚጠግን ቢገልጹም፣ የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲ መሪዎች ግን የተሻለ ስምምነት ማግኘት ስለመቻሉ ጥርጣሬ አላቸው።
oromo: Ministirri Muummee UK, Andy Burnham, waligaltee daldalaa biyyattii erga Brexit booda Gamtaa Awurooppaa waliin taasisan irra deebi'anii mari'achuuf karoorachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Kaayyoon jijjiirama kanaa dinagdee biyyattii cimsuu fi dhimma godaantotaa furuuf kan gargaaru yoo ta'u, daldala midhaanii irratti gufuuwwan jiran hir'isuu fi sagantaa dursa darbaa dargaggootaa haaraa hundeesuu kan of keessatti qabatu dha. Ministirri Muummee kun tarkaanfiin kun miidhaa diinagdee Brexit booda ga'e kan fooyyessu ta'uu amananis, hogganoonni mormituu garuu bu'aa gaariin ni argama jedhanii hin yaadan.

title: France school shooting: Police detain pupil after two injured
english: A 14-year-old student was arrested after using a hunting shotgun to injure two staff members at a middle school in Aubagne, France. The suspect concealed the weapon in a guitar case and fired multiple shots before a brave staff member intervened to disarm him. Fortunately, the victims are not in critical condition, and the school has been secured by authorities.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ ኦባኝ ከተማ በሚገኝ የሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት፣ የ14 ዓመት ተማሪ በአደን ጠመንጃ ሁለት የትምህርት ቤት ሠራተኞችን ካቆሰለ በኋላ በቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል። ተማሪው መሳሪያውን በጊታር መያዣ ውስጥ ደብቆ ወደ ትምህርት ቤቱ ካስገባ በኋላ ተኩስ የከፈተ ሲሆን፣ አንድ የትምህርት ቤቱ ሠራተኛ ጣልቃ በመግባት መሳሪያውን በመንጠቅ አደጋውን መቆጣጠር ችሏል። የተጎዱት ግለሰቦች ሁኔታ አሳሳቢ እንዳልሆነ እና ባለስልጣናት በጉዳዩ ላይ ምርመራ እያደረጉ መሆናቸው ተገልጿል።
oromo: Faransaayi magaalaa Aubagne keessatti barataan waggaa 14 tokko qawwee adamoo fayyadamuun hojjattoota mana barumsichaa lama miidhuun erga booda to'annoo jala ooleera. Barataan kun meesichaa keessa qabatee kan dhufe yoo ta'u, hojjataan mana barumsichaa tokko onnee argisiisuun isa irraa meesichaa hiikuun balaa kana dhaabuu danda'eera. Miidhamtoonni kun haala cimaa keessa kan hin jirre yoo ta'u, mootummaan qorannoo dhimma kanaa eegaleera.

title: Somalia’s Saudi-Backed Troop Incursion Raises Regional Stakes
english: Tensions have risen after Ethiopian security forces detained hundreds of Somali soldiers who crossed the border from Somalia without explanation. These troops were part of a large-scale, Saudi-funded training program aimed at professionalizing the Somali military. Ethiopia is now demanding clarity from both Mogadishu and Riyadh regarding the origin, purpose, and command structure of these forces.

title: Trump faces growing backlash over plans to import diesel from Russia
english: President Trump is facing criticism from lawmakers for agreeing to import large amounts of diesel from Russia to help lower fuel prices in the U.S. Critics argue that this deal contradicts existing laws and sanctions intended to block funding for Russia’s war in Ukraine. In response, a bipartisan group of senators has demanded that the President cancel the agreement, labeling it an unnecessary financial support for the Russian government.

oromo: Pirezidaanti Traamp gabaa Ameerikaa keessatti gatii boba’aa hir’isuuf jechuun Raashiyaa irraa daizilii hedduu bituuf karoorfachuu isaaniitiin mormii cimaa keessa galaniiru. Mormitoonni kun murtiin kun seeraafi uggura waraana Raashiyaa fi Yukreen irratti gita ga’u dhaabuuf ba’e faallessa jedhaniiru. Miseensoonni seeneetii gam lameenuu irraa walitti babahan, waliigalteen kun mootummaa Raashiyaaf deeggarsa maallaqaa waan ta’eef, akka hatattamaan dhaabbatu gaafataniiru.

title: Documents falsified to evade tax on Abramovich's wealth, BBC finds
english: A BBC investigation has revealed that the accounting firm Deloitte allegedly helped Roman Abramovich hide hundreds of millions of dollars in assets by falsifying company documents. This scheme reportedly allowed the former Chelsea owner to avoid significant tax payments on luxury items like superyachts and private jets. While legal experts describe the actions as clear tax evasion, Abramovich’s representatives and Deloitte have denied any wrongdoing or intentional misconduct.
amharic: የቢቢሲ ምርመራ እንደሚያሳየው የሂሳብ ተቋሙ ዲሎይት የሮማን አብራሞቪችን በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሚሊዮን ዶላር የሚገመት ንብረት በሀሰተኛ ሰነዶች እንዲደበቅ ረድቷል። ይህ ድርጊት የቀድሞው የቼልሲ ክለብ ባለቤት እንደ ሱፐር ጀልባዎች እና የግል አውሮፕላኖች ባሉ የቅንጦት ንብረቶች ላይ የሚከፈለውን ከፍተኛ ግብር እንዲያመልጥ አስችሎታል ተብሏል። የህግ ባለሙያዎች ድርጊቱን ግልጽ የሆነ የግብር ማጭበርበር ቢሉትም፣ የአብራሞቪች ጠበቆች እና ዲሎይት የተሰነዘረውን ክስ ውድቅ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Qorannoon BBC akka agarsiisutti, dhaabbanni herregaa Deloitte jedhamu, Roman Abramovich qabeenya isaa kan miliyoona dhibbaan lakkaa'amu sanadoota sobaa fayyadamuun akka dhoksu gargaareera. Karoorri kun abbaan qabeenyaa Chelsea durii kun, dooniiwwan gurguddaa fi xiyyaarota dhuunfaa irratti gibira guddaa akka hin kafalle isa dandeessiseera. Hayyoonni seeraa gocha kana akka malaammaltummaa gibiraa ifatti mul'atuutti kan ibsan yoo ta'u, bakka buutonni Abramovich fi dhaabbanni Deloitte himata dhiyaate kana gadi jabeessanii haalaniiru.

title: American ranchers wrestle with soaring costs - and their loyalty to Trump
english: Nebraska ranchers are struggling with high operational costs caused by natural disasters, expensive fuel, and increased steel prices. Many feel betrayed by the Trump administration's decision to import duty-free foreign beef, which threatens their local market profits. Consequently, some traditionally conservative farmers are reconsidering their political support as the upcoming election approaches.
amharic: የነብራስካ ከብት አርቢዎች በተፈጥሮ አደጋዎች፣ በነዳጅ ዋጋ ንረት እና በብረት እቃዎች መወደድ ሳቢያ ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ጫና ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ከውጭ የሚገቡ የስጋ ምርቶች ላይ ቀረጥ መጣል ማቆሙ የአካባቢውን ገበያ በመጉዳቱ አርቢዎቹ እንደ ክህደት አድርገው ወስደውታል። በዚህም ምክንያት ለረጅም ጊዜ ለሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ ታማኝ የነበሩ አርቢዎች በመጪው ምርጫ ድጋፋቸውን እንደገና እየገመገሙ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Horsiise bultoonni Nebraska balaa uumamaa, gatii bittaa boba’aa fi sibiilaa ol ka’e hordofee rakkoo diinagdee cimaa keessa jiru. Mootummaan Trump foon biyya alaatii galu irratti gibira kaasuun isaa gabaa keessoo fi bu’aa horsiisee bultootaa miidhuu isaa hordofee, namoonni hedduun akka ganamaatti itti dhaga’ameera. Haala kanaan, namoonni yeroo dheeraaf paartii Ripaabilikaanii deggeraa turan, filannoo dhufuuf jedhamuun walqabatee deggersa isaanii irra deebi’anii yaadaa jiru.

title: If Netanyahu goes, does anything really change for Palestinians?
english: Four Israeli opposition parties have united in an attempt to defeat Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in the upcoming October 27 elections. Despite this political challenge, experts believe a change in leadership is unlikely to result in significant shifts regarding policy toward Gaza or the West Bank. Both major political camps hold similar views on core issues, suggesting that the struggles faced by Palestinians will likely persist regardless of the election outcome.

oromo: Paartiileen mormituu Israa'el afur filannoo Sadaasa 27 dhufu irratti muummicha ministeeraa Beniyaamiin Neetaan yaahuu aangoo irraa buusuuf wal ta'aniiru. Ta'us, gorsitoonni siyaasaa akka jedhanitti, jijjiiramni mootummaa kun siyaasa Gazaafi bakkeewwan Lixaa irratti jijjiirama bu'uuraa fida jedhamee hin eeggamu. Gareewwan siyaasaa lamaanuu dhimmoota ijoo irratti yaada wal fakkaataa waan qabaniif, rakkoon ummata Palasxiin mudate filannoo boodas itti fufuun isaa ni mala.

title: India protest live: Opposition to march to Supreme Court over ‘vote theft’
english: The Indian National Congress party is planning a protest march to the Supreme Court to call for the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner due to accusations of electoral fraud. The opposition party claims that 130 million voters were unfairly removed from registration lists. However, the Chief Justice has declined a formal meeting, noting that these concerns are already part of ongoing legal proceedings.

oromo: Paartiin mormituu Indiyaa kan ta'e Indian National Congress, himata gowwomsaa sagalee kennuu irratti hundaahuun, komishinarri muummicha filannoo aangoo gadhiisuu qaba jedhee gara mana murtii olaanaatti hiriira ba'uuf karoorfateera. Paartiin mormituu kun namoonni miiliyoona 130 ta'an sirnaan ala galmee filannoo keessaa haqamaniiru jedhee himata. Ta'us, abbaan murtiin muummichi dhimmi kun ammayyuu mana murtii keessa waan jiruuf, gaggeessitoota paartichaa waliin wal arguuf fedhii hin qabaanne.

title: Countries warn against travel to Saudi Arabia following Houthi attacks
english: Several nations, including the U.S., Australia, and Canada, have issued travel warnings for Saudi Arabia due to a series of deadly Houthi militant attacks on the country's airports. These advisories urge citizens to avoid non-essential travel to the kingdom and specific high-risk locations following violent strikes that have caused fatalities and significant flight disruptions. Travelers are being encouraged to either cancel their plans or exercise extreme caution as the security situation remains unstable.

oromo: Houthi’onni buufata xiyyaaraa Saudi Arabia irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaanii hordofee, biyyoonni hedduun kan akka Ameerikaa, Awustiraaliyaa fi Kaanaadaa lammiilee isaaniitiif akeekkachiisa imalaa baasaniiru. Haleellaan kunneen lubbuu namaa galaafachuu fi tajaajila xiyyaaraa irratti gufuu guddaa waan uumaniif, biyyoonni kunneen lammiileen isaanii imala dirqamaa hin taane akka dhaaban gorsaniiru. Haalli nageenyaa naannichaa waan hin amanamneef, namoonni imala karoorfatan akka of eeggannoo guddaa godhan ykn imala isaanii akka haqan jajjabeeffamaa jiru.

title: China sanctions Paraguay, Belize ministers over Taiwan ties
english: China has imposed sanctions on the communications minister of Paraguay and the foreign minister of Belize due to their countries' ongoing diplomatic ties with Taiwan. These measures include freezing their assets, banning them from entering Hong Kong and Macau, and prohibiting any Chinese entities from working with them. Beijing claims these officials are undermining its national interests by supporting Taiwan, which China considers part of its own territory.

oromo: Chaayinaan biyyoonni Paaraaguwaay fi Beeliiz taayiiwaanii wajjin hariiroo diippiloomaasii qabaachuu isaanii mormuun, ministiroota biyyoota lameenii irratti tarkaanfii fudhatteetti. Chaayinaan ministiroonni kunneen Taayiiwaaniin biyya ishee keessaa akka taatetti waan lakkooytuuf, deeggarsa isaan taayiiwaaniif kennaniin faayidaa biyya ishee miidhaniiru jetti.

title: UK PM Andy Burnham says it is ‘clear’ Russia interfered in 2016 Brexit vote
english: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham has publicly stated that Russia interfered in the 2016 Brexit referendum, marking the first time a sitting leader has made such an acknowledgement. While he offered no specific evidence, he emphasized the importance of this revelation to warn voters in France and Germany about similar threats to their own political processes. The Prime Minister also noted that this foreign influence undermines democratic integrity and suggested that these issues require increased public awareness.

oromo: Mummichi Ministeera UK Andy Burnham akka jedhutti, biyyi Raashiyaa waggaa 2016 sagalee kennii Brexit irratti dhiibbaa gochuun akka harka keessu ifatti dubbataniiru. Mummichi ministeerichaa ragaa tokko malee yoo dubbatanis, kana kan godhaniif biyyoonni akka Faransaay fi Jarmanii dhiibbaa akkanaa irraa of eeguu akka qaban akeekkachiisuufi. Ta'iinsi kun adeemsa dimokiraasii biyyoota dhihaa irratti dhiibbaan alaanii guddaa ta'uu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Iran’s FM urges diplomacy in call with Saudi counterpart
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi contacted his Saudi counterpart to advocate for diplomatic dialogue over military force following recent Houthi attacks on Saudi airports. Tehran has offered to mediate talks between Saudi Arabia and the Houthi movement to resolve the ongoing conflict peacefully. This diplomatic outreach comes amidst rising regional tensions and potential shifts in US military involvement following the deadly strikes in Riyadh.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ በሳዑዲ አረቢያ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያዎች ላይ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ከተፈጸመው ጥቃት በኋላ ከሳዑዲ አቻቸው ጋር በስልክ ተወያይተዋል። ሚኒስትሩ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ መፍትሄ እንደማያመጣ በመግለጽ፣ ችግሮችን በሰላማዊ መንገድ ለመፍታት የዲፕሎማሲ ንግግሮች እንዲጀመሩ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ኢራን በሳዑዲ እና በየመን ሁቲዎች መካከል ድርድር እንዲኖር ለማገዝ ፈቃደኛ መሆኗን ገልጻለች።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iraan Abbas Araagchi, erga haleellaa gareen Huutii buufataalee xiyyaraa Sa'udii irratti raawwatee booda, ministira dhimma alaa Sa'udii waliin bilbilan dubbataniiru. Ministirichi rakkoon naannichaa karaa waraanaan furamuu akka hin dandeenye ibsuun, marii fi dipiloomaasiidhaaf xiyyeeffannoon kennamuu akka qabu dhaamaniiru. Iraan, mootummaan Sa'udii fi gareen Huutii marii nagaa akka jalqaban gargaaruuf qophii ta'uu ishee ibsiteetti.

title: Hurricane Isaias leaves trail of destruction across the US Gulf Coast
english: Hurricane Isaias recently hit the U.S. Gulf Coast as a Category 2 storm, causing significant damage and leaving hundreds of thousands of people without electricity in Florida and Alabama. The severe weather resulted in at least four deaths and destroyed various buildings, leading to emergency repair efforts and critical water shortages in some areas. While the storm has since weakened, authorities continue to warn residents in the path of the cyclone about the ongoing risk of flash flooding.

oromo: Hurricane Isaias dhiheenya kana qarqara galaana Yunaayitid Isteets rukutee, Florida fi Alabama keessatti miidhaa guddaa geessisuudhaan namoota kuma dhibbootatti lakkaa'aman ibsaa dhabsiiseera. Obombolettiin cimaan kun namoota afur galaafatee fi manneen hedduu mancaasuun, naannoolee tokko tokko keessatti hanqina bishaan dhugaatii hammaataa uumeera. Amma obombolettiin kun humna isaa hir'iseus, qaamoleen mootummaa bakkeewwan balaan lolaa itti fufuu danda'u keessa jiraatan akka of eeggannoo godhan akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Ceuta or Sebta? Why one city has two names and a disputed status
english: King Felipe VI of Spain is making his first official visit to the North African coastal cities of Ceuta and Melilla, reigniting long-standing tensions over their sovereignty. While Spain maintains these cities as its own territory, Morocco continues to claim them, highlighting a deep-rooted historical and political dispute. The city's two names, Ceuta and Sebta, reflect its complex history of passing through various Muslim dynasties before its conquest by Portugal in 1415 and eventual transfer to Spain.

english: A Saudi-led military coalition successfully destroyed a ballistic missile fired by Houthi rebels aimed at the city of Khamis Mushait. While warning alerts were also triggered in the southern city of Abha, officials confirmed that the immediate threat has been neutralized. No injuries or major damages were reported following these interceptions.

english: UK Green Party leader Zack Polanski is calling for internal reforms to grant party leadership more authority over strategic policy decisions. title: Deadly air strike kills dozens at Sudan gold mine near Egypt border
english: At least 72 people were killed and over 50 others injured following an air strike on a gold mine located near Sudan’s border with Egypt. Human rights organizations reported the attack, which has caused significant casualties in the area. To date, no individual group or party has claimed responsibility for the deadly strike.
amharic: በሱዳን እና በግብፅ ድንበር አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ የወርቅ ማዕድን ማውጫ ላይ በተፈጸመ የቦምብ ጥቃት ቢያንስ 72 ሰዎች ሲሞቱ ከ50 በላይ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ቡድኖች እንደገለጹት ጥቃቱ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አስከትሏል። እስካሁን ድረስ ጥቃቱን የፈጸመ አካል በይፋ የታወቀ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Sudaanii fi Gibxi gidduutti daangaa irra kan argamu bakka warqee itti baafatan irratti haleellaa xiyyaaraan taasifameen namoonni 72 yoo du'an, 50 ol ta'an immoo miidhamaniiru. Gareewwan mirga namoomaa akka gabaasanitti, haleellaan kun miidhaa hamaa geessiseera. Hanga ammaatti gareen ykn qaamni haleellaa kana raawwate jedhee itti gaafatamummaa fudhate hin jiru.

title: How Man City beat Liverpool after guilty verdict
english: Manchester City recently secured a victory against Liverpool in a football match at Anfield. During the game, fans taunted the visiting team regarding their ongoing legal issues and recent guilty verdict. Spectators openly questioned the future of the club within the Premier League due to these serious allegations.
amharic: ማንችስተር ሲቲ በቅርቡ በሊቨርፑል ላይ በሜዳቸው ባደረጉት ጨዋታ ድልን ተቀዳጅተዋል። በጨዋታው ወቅት የሊቨርፑል ደጋፊዎች የሲቲን የቅርብ ጊዜ የጥፋተኝነት ውሳኔ በማስታወስ ቡድኑን በስላቅ ተቀብለዋል። የክለቡ የህግ ችግሮች ከባድ በመሆናቸው፣ ቀጣይነታቸው በእንግሊዝ ፕሪሚየር ሊግ ውስጥ ምን እንደሚሆን የደጋፊዎቹ ጥያቄ ሆኗል።
oromo: Maanchistar Siitii dhiheenya kana tapha kubbaa miilaa Anfield irratti taasifameen Liiverpuul injifateera. Taphicha gidduutti, deeggartoonni Liiverpuul murtii yakkaa isaan irratti darbe yaadachiisuun Siitiin irratti qoosaniiru. Dhimmi seerummaa kun cimaa waan ta'eef, gara fuulduraatti Siitiin Liigii Piriimerii Ingilizii keessa turuu danda'a moo hin danda'u kan jedhu yaaddoo qabachuun isaanii mul'ateera.

title: Iran says US response falls short of conditions for deal
english: Iran's security chief, Mohsen Rezaei, has stated that recent American proposals are insufficient to meet their demands for reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Tehran is insisting on the removal of oil sanctions and an end to the U.S. naval blockade before they will resume negotiations. Officials emphasized that Iran's diplomatic stance has evolved and they will not return to previous conditions without their specific requirements being fully satisfied.
amharic: የኢራን የፀጥታ ሃላፊ ሞህሰን ረዛኢ የአሜሪካ የቅርብ ጊዜ ምላሾች የሆርሙዝን የባህር በር ለመክፈት የሚያስፈልጉትን ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች አያሟሉም ብለዋል። ቴህራን ድርድሩን ከመጀመሯ በፊት የአሜሪካ የነዳጅ ማዕቀቦች እንዲነሱ እና የባህር ላይ እገዳው እንዲቆም ትጠይቃለች። የኢራን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ አካሄድ እንደተቀየረ የገለጹት ሃላፊው፣ ቅድመ ሁኔታዎቻቸው ሙሉ በሙሉ ሳይሟሉ ወደ ቀድሞ ሁኔታቸው እንደማይመለሱ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan nageenyaa Iraan Mohsen Rezaei, yaaliin fi deebiin Ameerikaan dhiyeessite kan qarqara galaana Hormuz banuuf gahaa miti jedhaniiru. Iraan marii idileetti deebi'uuf dura dhorkaa boba'aa fi dhiibbaa galaana irraa irratti taasifame akka kaasuuf gaafachaa jirti. Aangewtoonni kunneen, haalli dipiloomaasii Iraan jijjiiramuu fi akkaataa barbaadan guutuu malee gara haala duriitti akka hin deebine ibsaniiru.

title: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Egypt and Turkey demand end to Houthi attacks
english: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and Turkey have jointly called for an immediate stop to Houthi missile and drone strikes against Saudi territory. The four nations condemned these actions as illegal violations of sovereignty that pose a significant risk to civilian safety and regional stability. By standing with Saudi Arabia, the coalition emphasized that the Houthi group bears full responsibility for these ongoing attacks.
amharic: ፓኪስታን፣ ሳዑዲ አረቢያ፣ ግብፅ እና ቱርክ በሳዑዲ አረቢያ ላይ የሚፈጸሙ የሁቲ ሚሳኤል እና ድሮን ጥቃቶች በአስቸኳይ እንዲቆሙ በጋራ ጠይቀዋል። እነዚህ አገራት ጥቃቶቹን የዓለም አቀፍ ህግን የሚጥሱ እና ለሲቪሎች ደህንነት ስጋት የፈጠሩ ድርጊቶች ናቸው በማለት አውግዘዋል። ጥምረቱ ከሳዑዲ አረቢያ ጎን በመቆም፣ ለቀጠሉት ጥቃቶች ሁሉንም ተጠያቂነት በሁቲ ቡድን ላይ ጥለዋል።
oromo: Paakistaan, Saudii Arabiyaa, Gibxii fi Turkiin haleellaa meeshaa waraanaa fi xiyyaara malee kan Hutiin Saudii Arabiyaa irratti raawwatan hatattamaan akka dhaabatu gaafataniiru. Biyyoonni arfan kun haleellaa kana seera idil-addunyaa cabsuu fi nageenya namoota nagaa balaaf kan saaxilu ta'uu ibsuun balaaleffataniiru. Biyyoonni kun Saudii Arabiyaa cinaa dhaabbachuun, haleellaa kanaaf itti gaafatamummaan guutuun garee Hutii akka ta'e beeksisaniiru.

title: Saudi authority confirms Houthi attack on Dammam airport
english: Saudi aviation authorities have confirmed that Houthi rebels launched an attack on King Fahd International Airport in Dammam. This incident follows a claim of responsibility from the Houthi group regarding the strike on the facility in the kingdom's Eastern Province. Officials are currently on-site evaluating the extent of the damage caused by the assault.
amharic: የሳውዲ አረቢያ የአቪዬሽን ባለስልጣናት የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በዳማም በሚገኘው የንጉስ ፋህድ አለም አቀፍ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አረጋግጠዋል። የሁቲ ቡድን በምስራቃዊው የሳውዲ አውራጃ በሚገኘው በዚህ ተቋም ላይ ጥቃት ማድረሱን በይፋ አስታውቋል። ባለስልጣናቱ በአሁኑ ወቅት በደረሰው ጉዳት መጠን ላይ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Abbaan taayitaa geejjiba xiyyaaraa Saudii akka ibsetti, gareen Huutii buufata xiyyaaraa idil-addunyaa King Fahd kan magaalaa Dammamirratti haleellaa raawwateera. Gareen Huutii haleellaa kana kan raawwate ta'uu isaa erga mirkaneeffatee booda, qaamoleen mootummaa miidhaa qaqqabe qorachaa jiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame naannoo bahaa biyyattii keessatti dha.

title: Fresh attack hits Riyadh airport as Houthis warn airlines against using Saudi airspace
english: Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport has been hit by a second consecutive day of attacks, causing injuries and forcing the facility to remain closed. The Houthi movement has claimed responsibility for these strikes and warned airlines to avoid Saudi airspace, labeling the area a legitimate military target. This latest escalation follows a devastating attack on Saturday that resulted in significant casualties.
amharic: የሪያድ ንጉስ ካሊድ ዓለም አቀፍ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ለሁለት ተከታታይ ቀናት በደረሰ ጥቃት ጉዳት ደርሶበታል፣ ይህም የሰው ህይወት መቁሰሉን እና የአየር ማረፊያው እንዲዘጋ አድርጓል። የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ጥቃቱን እንደፈፀሙ በማመን የአየር መንገዶች የሳውዲን የአየር ክልል እንዳይጠቀሙ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ይህ ክስተት ባለፈው ቅዳሜ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ካደረሰው ሌላ ጥቃት ጋር ተያይዞ የተከሰተ ነው።
oromo: Buufanni xiyyaaraa idil-addunyaa King Khalid kan Riyaad guyyaa lama walitti aansuun erga haleelamee booda, namootni miidhamuun buufatichis akka cufamu ta'eera. Gareen Huutii haleellaa kana raawwachuu isaa ibsuun, xiyyaarotni qilleensa Sa'udii akka hin fayyadamne akeekkachiiseera. Haleellaan kun kan hordofe haleellaa guddaa Dilbata darbe raawwatamee fi lubbuu namootaa galaafate dha.

title: Saudi capital airport hit by second Houthi strike in two days
english: For the second time in two days, the Houthi rebel group launched a strike on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, causing a fire and reported injuries. The attackers used a combination of missiles and drones, warning travelers to avoid Saudi airspace as they escalate their offensive. This follows a previous, more lethal attack on the same airport, prompting international condemnation and pledges of a strong response from Saudi officials.
amharic: ለሁለተኛ ተከታታይ ቀናት የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ ዋና ከተማ ሪያድ በሚገኘው የኪንግ ካሊድ ዓለም አቀፍ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ላይ ጥቃት አድርሰዋል። ጥቃቱ በእሳት ቃጠሎ እና በአንዳንድ ሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት ያስከተለ ሲሆን፣ ታጣቂዎቹ ተጨማሪ ጥቃቶችን እንደሚፈጽሙ በማስጠንቀቅ በሳውዲ አየር ክልል እንዳይጠቀሙ ለአየር መንገዶች ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ይህ ድርጊት ቀደም ሲል በዚሁ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ላይ ከፍተኛ የሰው ህይወት የቀጠፈ ጥቃት መፈጸሙን ተከትሎ የመጣ ሲሆን፣ ሳውዲ አረቢያ ለጥቃቱ ጠንካራ ምላሽ እንደምትሰጥ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Guyyoota lama keessatti yeroo lammaffaaf, gareen finxaaleyyii Huutii buufata xiyyaaraa idil-addunyaa King Khalid kan Riyaad, Saudii Arabiyaa irratti haleellaa raawwataniiru. Haleellaan kun ibidda kaasee fi namoota irra miidhaa geessiseera; gareen kunis gara fuulduraatti haleellaa caalu akka raawwatan akeekkachiisuun, xiyyaarotni qilleensa Saudi keessa akka hin darbine dubbataniiru. Haleellaan kun buufata xiyyaaraa kana irratti yeroo darbe miidhaa guddaa geessisee tureen walqabatee kan dhufe yoo ta'u, mootummaan Saudi Arabiyaas tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhatu waadaa galeera.

title: Poland detains man suspected of planning assassination of PM Tusk
english: Polish authorities have arrested a man suspected of plotting to assassinate Prime Minister Donald Tusk and the defense minister. Officials took the threat very seriously after receiving intelligence about the planned attacks, leading to a swift response by security services. The suspect, a Polish national, was captured in the Lower Silesia region following an investigation triggered by an alert regarding the potential violence.
amharic: የፖላንድ ባለስልጣናት ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ዶናልድ ቱስክን እና የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩን ለመግደል አቅዶ የነበረውን ግለሰብ በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። የደህንነት ተቋማት ስለተጠነሰሰው ጥቃት አስተማማኝ መረጃ እንደደረሳቸው አስታውቀው፣ ጉዳዩን ከፍተኛ ስጋት በመውሰድ ፈጣን እርምጃ ወስደዋል። በሎወር ሲሌሲያ ክልል የተያዘው የፖላንድ ዜጋ፣ ጥቃቱን ለመፈጸም ሲያሴር እንደነበር ተገልጿል።
oromo: Mootummaan Pooland namicha ajjeechaa Ministira Muummee Donald Tusk fi Ministira ittisaa irratti raawwachuuf karoorfate jedhame shakkiin qabame to'annoo jala oolcheera. Qaamoleen nageenyaa gabaasa balaa kanaa hordofuun tarkaanfii ariifachiisaa fudhataniiru. Namichi lammii Pooland ta'e kun naannoo Lower Silesia keessatti kan qabame yoo ta'u, hidhattoonni nageenyaa karoora kana irratti qorannoo cimaa gaggeessaa jiru.

title: Poland stabbings driven by online glorification of violence, Tusk says
english: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk has linked a recent surge in school stabbings to the online glorification of violence and extreme right-wing ideology. Following these attacks, which resulted in one death and multiple injuries, police have detained over 100 individuals for making threats or carrying weapons. Authorities are now increasing security at schools nationwide to address the growing trend of young people being radicalized by internet content.

english: Palestinians in Gaza are escaping their homes due to intensifying Israeli military strikes. In addition to the violence in Gaza, communities in the occupied West Bank and East Jerusalem are facing increased threats from settler aggression and the destruction of their houses. These combined actions have created a widespread humanitarian crisis for Palestinians across these territories.

title: Lebanon’s first electric train hopes to revive railway system
english: Lebanon has launched a new solar-powered model train on a portion of its old railway tracks. This initiative aims to spark renewed public interest in the nation's historical rail system which has been inactive for many years. Officials hope this project will eventually lead to the revitalization of the country's broader transportation and tourism infrastructure.

title: Liverpool fans give Manchester City a fiery welcome at Anfield
english: Liverpool supporters gave the Manchester City team a hostile reception upon their arrival at Anfield by calling them cheats. This intense atmosphere occurred during City's first Premier League game following their conviction for major financial rule violations. Despite the pressure from the home crowd, Manchester City went on to win the match 3-0.

Dhiibbaa deggertoota ganda isaanii keessatti argatanis, Manchester City taphicha 3-0 injifateera.

title: Man City beat 10-man Liverpool 3-0 in first game after guilty verdict
english: Manchester City secured a 3-0 victory against 10-man Liverpool shortly after being found guilty of numerous financial rule breaches. Second-half goals from Erling Haaland, Jeremy Doku, and Rayan Cherki ensured City maintained their lead at the top of the Premier League table. The club currently faces potential severe sanctions, including points deductions or expulsion, following an investigation into inflated revenues between 2009 and 2018.

title: Is the Yemen war entering a new phase?
english: Saudi Arabia has reported that a Houthi attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh resulted in 12 deaths and 300 injuries. This violent incident has raised concerns about a major escalation in the ongoing conflict between Saudi forces and the Houthi group. Experts are now questioning whether these events signal the beginning of a more intense phase of the war.

title: Six Pakistanis wounded and Indian national dies after Riyadh airport attack
english: A Houthi militant attack on Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport has resulted in the death of one Indian national and injuries to six Pakistani citizens. Saudi aviation authorities reported a total of 12 fatalities and over 300 injuries following the strike. Pakistan's Prime Minister has expressed his condolences and confirmed that the country's embassy is providing support to the affected families.

title: Iran’s security chief calls US response to deal conditions ‘inadequate’
english: Iran's security chief, Mohsen Rezaei, has labeled the latest US response to their deal conditions as insufficient. He stated that Iran will not offer further replies until Washington provides more clarity on the remaining disputed issues. This impasse follows recent disagreements over uranium enrichment demands and the potential reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Iran’s security chief accuses Trump administration of oil smuggling near Oman
english: Mohsen Rezaei, a senior Iranian security official, has alleged that the U.S. government is orchestrating an illegal oil smuggling operation near the coast of Oman. He claimed that the UAE and U.S. military leadership are involved in using small boats to move oil onto larger tankers. Rezaei further asserted that Iran is actively countering these activities by attacking the vessels involved, emphasizing that Iran maintains control over the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Houthis claim responsibility for deadly Riyadh airport attack
english: Yemeni Houthi forces have claimed responsibility for a missile strike on Riyadh’s King Khalid Airport that killed 12 people and injured hundreds more. The attack led to a total shutdown of airport operations and also targeted other critical infrastructure sites, including refineries and additional airports in Saudi Arabia. This event marks one of the deadliest assaults in the Gulf region since regional conflicts escalated in late February.

oromo: Humni Hutiin Yaman, haleellaa misa'elaa buufata xiyyaaraa King Khalid kan Riyaaditti raawwatamee fi lubbuu namoota 12 galaafate akkasumas namoota dhibbaan lakkaawaman miidheef itti gaafatamummaa fudhateera. Haleellaan kun waraanni fi walitti bu'iinsi naannichaatti erga jalqabee as, kanneen naannoo Goolfiitti raawwataman keessaa isa hanga ammaa namoota baay'ee miidhe keessaa tokko dha.

title: Seventy-two killed in air strike on gold mine near Sudan-Egypt border
english: A Sudanese rights organization has reported that an Egyptian military airstrike hit a gold mine near the border with Sudan, killing at least 72 civilian workers. The incident occurred on Saturday, and investigators are currently working to confirm the final number of victims. No official response has been issued yet regarding the cause or intent behind this deadly attack.

title: Ukraine strikes Yandex data centre in third attack on Russian tech giant
english: Ukrainian drone strikes have damaged a Yandex data center near Moscow, marking the third attack on the Russian technology company this week. The incident forced the firm to suspend operations at the facility, impacting several digital services used by millions. This campaign aims to disrupt Russian infrastructure and economic resources as both nations continue to target each other's critical systems.

title: Pope Leo to have surgery after lump found on lung
english: Pope Leo XIV has announced that he will undergo surgery next week to remove a small, localized nodule discovered on his lung during a routine examination. The 71-year-old leader is expected to remain in the hospital for about a week to recover. Despite the upcoming procedure, the Vatican confirmed that the Pope's planned trip to South America in November will proceed as scheduled.

title: Homes and bridges swept away as fresh floods hit Nepal
english: Severe flash flooding in Nepal's Gorkha district has destroyed numerous homes, bridges, and parts of a hydropower facility. While around 50 people were rescued, five remain missing as communities face displacement during a major national festival. Authorities are investigating the cause of the surge, which comes just months after the country suffered catastrophic floods that claimed over 1,400 lives.

title: US justice department investigates TV networks over Trump pool coverage
english: The U.S. Department of Justice is looking into whether major television networks violated federal competition laws by temporarily stopping their shared coverage of President Trump. This protest occurred after the administration revoked the press credentials of several journalists, prompting a boycott by five news organizations. Authorities are now reviewing internal communications to determine if this coordinated action constitutes an illegal monopolistic practice.

title: Creating a ghost town: Lives in limbo behind Israeli gates and checkpoints
english: In the H2 area of Hebron, Israeli authorities have significantly restricted Palestinian movement by installing additional iron gates and enforcing strict checkpoints. These measures have severely disrupted daily life for thousands of residents, effectively turning parts of the city into a ghost town. With limited access hours and strict identification requirements, many Palestinians feel that these policies are designed to push them out of their own neighborhoods.

oromo: Magaalaa Hebron, naannoo H2 jedhamutti, mootummaan Israa'el balbala sibiilaa dabalataa fi daangaawwan qorannoo cimaa diriirsuun sochii warra Falasxiin irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumteetti. Tarkaanfileen kunneen jireenya guyyaa guyyaa namoota dubbiin kun isaan ilaallatu iratti rakkoo hamaa uumee, akkasumas kutaalee magaalaa tokko tokko gara ganda namni hin jiraanneetti akka jijjiiraman taasiseera. Namoonni kunneen yeroo daangeffamee fi ulaagaa waraqaa eenyummaa cimaan waan itti murameef, ganda isaanii keessaa akka ba'an dirqisiifamaa jiraachuu isaanii dubbatu.

title: Cockroach Janta Party accuses Modi of ‘waging war’ on Indians
english: Leaders of the Cockroach Janta Party have accused the Modi government of declaring war on its citizens following their recent 24-hour detention. They allege that election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar is actively suppressing voters to unfairly favor the ruling BJP party. The opposition members claim these actions undermine democratic processes to maintain the prime minister's political power.
amharic: የኮክሮች ጃንታ ፓርቲ መሪዎች ለ24 ሰዓታት ታስረው ከተለቀቁ በኋላ የሞዲ መንግስት በዜጎች ላይ ጦርነት አውጇል ሲሉ ከሰሱ። የፓርቲው አመራሮች የምርጫ ኮሚሽነር ጂያኔሽ ኩማር ገዢውን የቢጄፒ ፓርቲ ለመጥቀም ሲባል መራጮችን ከምርጫ ሂደት እያገሉ ነው ሲሉ ይከሳሉ። ይህ ድርጊት የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩን ስልጣን ለማስጠበቅ የታለመ የዴሞክራሲ ጥሰት ነው ሲሉም አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni paartii Cockroach Janta erga guyyaa tokkoof hidhamanii gadhiifamanii booda, mootummaan Modi lammiilee isaa irratti waraana labseera jechuun himatan. Komishinarri filannoo Gyaanash Kumaar, paartii biyya bulchu BJP fayyaduuf jecha sagalee kennitootaa akka hin dabarfanne gochuun isaanii himatameera. Hoggantoonni mormituu kunneen gochi kun aangoo muummicha ministeeraa itti fufsiisuuf jecha sirna dimokiraasii miidhaa jira jedhu.

title: India’s crackdown on youth protesters: What next?
english: Young activists in India, led by the 'Cockroach' movement, are continuing their protests following a widespread crackdown and mass detentions by authorities. The demonstrators are demanding the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner, alleging that voter list revisions unfairly favor the ruling party. Although many protesters were initially detained, they were released after the Supreme Court ruled the arrests illegal, fueling further opposition against Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
amharic: በህንድ የሚገኙ ወጣት አክቲቪስቶች የ'ኮክሮች' ንቅናቄን በመምራት በባለስልጣናት የደረሰባቸውን እስር እና ጭቆና ተቋቁመው ተቃውሟቸውን ቀጥለዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ የምርጫ ኮሚሽነሩን ስልጣን መልቀቅ የሚጠይቁ ሲሆን፣ የምርጫ ዝርዝር ማሻሻያው ገዥውን ፓርቲ ተጠቃሚ የሚያደርግ ነው ብለዋል። ምንም እንኳን በርካታ ተቃዋሚዎች ታስረው የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤቱ እስሩን ህገ-ወጥ በማለቱ ከእስር ተለቀዋል፤ ይህ ደግሞ በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ናሬንድራ ሞዲ ላይ ያለውን ተቃውሞ ይበልጥ አቀጣጥሎታል።
oromo: Duula 'Cockroach' jedhamuun kan durfamu dargaggoonni Indiyaa, ukkaamsaa fi hidhaa mootummaan isaan irratti raawwateen boodas mormii isaanii itti fufanii jiru. Mormitoonni kun Komishinara Ol’aanaa Filannoo akka gadhiisu gaafachaa kan jiran yoo ta’u, sirreeffamni galmee filannoo paartii bulchaa jiruuf kan gogogogu dha jedhanii mormu. Mormitoonni hedduu hidhamanii turan illee, Mana Murtii Olaanaan hidhaan sun seeraan alaa dha jedhee murteessuu isaa hordofee gadi lakkifamaniiru; kunis mormiin itti fufuuf sababa ta’eera.

title: Ceuta migrants allege beatings as camps cleared ahead of royal visit
english: Migrants living in Ceuta have accused Spanish soldiers of physical abuse during the forced removal of their camps. These evictions occurred just before a scheduled official visit to the Spanish enclave by the King and Queen of Spain. The situation remains sensitive due to ongoing border tensions between Spain and Morocco, which maintains a sovereignty claim over the territory.
amharic: በሴኡታ የሚኖሩ ስደተኞች የስፔን ወታደሮች መጠለያቸውን በሚያፈርሱበት ወቅት ድብደባ እንደፈጸሙባቸው ከሰዋል። ይህ ድርጊት የተፈጸመው የስፔን ንጉሥ እና ንግሥት ወደ ስፍራው ሊያደርጉት የነበረውን ጉብኝት ተከትሎ ነው። በስፔን እና በሞሮኮ መካከል ባለው የሉዓላዊነት ይገባኛል ጥያቄ ምክንያት በግዛቷ ላይ ያለው ውጥረት አሁንም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Godina Se’uta keessa kan jiraatan godaantotni, waraanni Ispeen buufata isaanii diiguu keessatti akka reebaman himatan. Arii’atamni kun kan raawwatame Mootiin Ispeen fi mootittiin daawwannaa gochuuf qophiirra osoo jiranidha. Ispeen fi Morookoon bulchiinsa naannicharratti wal dhabde waan qabaniif, haalli naannichaa ammas xiyyeeffannoo barbaada.

title: Meet the man helping India’s detained protesters get home
english: A 25-year-old developer in India has created an artificial intelligence-based application to assist protesters who are detained and then abandoned by police on the city outskirts. The technology helps these individuals navigate their way back to safety after being left in unfamiliar or remote areas. This initiative provides a crucial lifeline for activists facing legal challenges and isolation.
amharic: በህንድ የሚኖር የ25 ዓመት ወጣት በፖሊስ ታስረው ከከተማ ዳርቻዎች በሚጣሉ ተቃዋሚዎች ላይ የሚያግዝ የሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) መተግበሪያ ፈጥሯል። ይህ ቴክኖሎጂ ተቃዋሚዎች ከታሰሩ በኋላ ባልታወቁ አካባቢዎች ሲለቀቁ በሰላም ወደ ቤታቸው እንዲመለሱ ያስችላቸዋል። ይህ የፈጠራ ስራ ለተቃዋሚዎች ትልቅ የደህንነት ድጋፍ እየሰጠ ይገኛል።
oromo: dargaggeessi umuriin isaa waggaa 25 ta'e tokko Hindii keessatti, namoota mormii irratti hirmaatanii poolisiin qabamanii magaalaa alaatti gadi dhiifaman gargaaruuf appilikeeshinii 'artificial intelligence' fayyadamu tokko tolcheera. Teeknoolojiin kun namoonni bakka hin beekamnetti gadi dhiifaman kun karaa nagaa ta'een gara mana isaanii akka deebi'an gargaara. Kaayyoon kun namoota mirga isaaniif falmatan kanneen rakkina keessa jiraniif deeggarsa guddaa ta'a.

title: UKMTO says it received report of tanker hit by projectile in Hormuz
english: A tanker traveling through the Strait of Hormuz was struck by an unknown object on Sunday, resulting in physical damage to the ship. Fortunately, all crew members are unharmed, and there are no reports of environmental contamination. Authorities have launched an investigation to determine the origin of the projectile.
amharic: እሁድ ዕለት በሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ አቋርጦ ይጓዝ የነበረ መርከብ በማይታወቅ ነገር ተመትቶ ጉዳት ደርሶበታል። ምንም እንኳን በመርከቡ ላይ ጉዳት ቢደርስም፣ ሁሉም ሰራተኞች ደህና ናቸው እንዲሁም ምንም አይነት የአካባቢ ብክለት አልተከሰተም። ጉዳዩን አስመልክቶ የሚመለከታቸው አካላት ምርመራ እየጀመሩ ነው።
oromo: Dilbata darbe markabni tokko iddoo Hormuz jedhamu keessa yeroo darbu miidhaan irra ga'eera. Miidhaan kun kan ga'e meeshaa eenyummaansaa hin beekamneen rukutamuu isaatiin ta'uu UKMTO ibseera. Hojjettoonni markabichaa hundi nagaa qabu, akkasumas miidhaan naannoo irra ga'e hin jiru; qaamoleen dhimmi ilaallatu qorannoo eegalaniiru.

title: Air strikes reported on Yemen’s Sanaa airport
english: Houthi media sources reported that Saudi Arabia launched air strikes against Sanaa International Airport and the Amran governorate in Yemen. These attacks follow a series of recent Houthi strikes targeting Saudi Arabian airports, including those in the capital, Riyadh. The Saudi-led coalition has not yet issued a statement regarding these latest developments.
amharic: የሁቲ ሚዲያዎች ሳውዲ አረቢያ በየመን ሰንዓ ዓለም አቀፍ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ እና በአምራን ግዛት ላይ የአየር ጥቃት መፈጸሟን ዘግበዋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የተፈጸሙት ሁቲዎች ባለፈው ሳምንት በሳውዲ አረቢያ ዋና ከተማ ሪያድን ጨምሮ በተለያዩ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያዎች ላይ ጥቃት ካደረሱ በኋላ ነው። በሳውዲ የሚመራው ጥምረት እስካሁን በጉዳዩ ላይ ምንም ዓይነት መግለጫ አልሰጠም።
oromo: Miidiyaaleen Huthotaa akka gabaasanitti, Saudii Arabiyaan buufata xiyyaaraa idil-addunyaa San’aa fi naannoo Amraan irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwachuu ishee ibsameera. Haleellaan kun kan hordofe, guyyoota darbanitti Huthoti magaalaa guddoo Saudi Arabiyaa Riyaad dabalatee buufataalee xiyyaaraa biyyattii irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaanii ti. Gamtaan Saudii durfamu gama isaanin hanga ammaatti waa'ee haleellaa kanaa ibsa tokkollee hin kennine.

title: Attacks by 'Iran’s proxies' pushing region into spiral of violence, says EU on Riyadh airport strike
english: The European Union has strongly condemned a deadly attack by Houthi rebels on Saudi Arabia's King Khalid International Airport, which resulted in at least 12 deaths and hundreds of injuries. EU officials characterized the strike as a dangerous act of terror and a major escalation that threatens regional stability by targeting civilian infrastructure. International leaders have urged an immediate halt to these attacks, while global flight operations at the airport remain severely disrupted.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ህብረት በሳዑዲ አረቢያ የኪንግ ካሊድ ዓለም አቀፍ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ላይ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የተፈጸመውን የሞት አደጋ ያስከተለ ጥቃት አወገዘ። ጥቃቱ ቢያንስ 12 ሰዎችን ለህልፈት የዳረገ ሲሆን ከ300 በላይ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የአውሮፓ ህብረት መሪዎች ይህንን ድርጊት የክልሉን ሰላም የሚያናጋ አደገኛ የሽብር ተግባር ሲሉ የገለጹት ሲሆን፣ በንፁሀን ላይ የሚደረገው ጥቃት በአስቸኳይ እንዲቆም ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Gamtaan Awurooppaa haleellaa qondaaltota Huutii buufata xiyyaaraa King Khalid kan Saudii Arabiyaatti raawwatamee fi lubbuu namoota 12 galaafate akkasumas namoota 300 ol miidhe balaaleffateera. Hogganoonni Gamtaichaa haleellaa kana gocha shororkeessummaa fi nagaa naannichaa kan boorreesse jechuun ibsaniiru. Miidhaa nagaa-bultoota irra ga'aa jiru kana akka hatattamaan dhaaban kan gaafataman yoo ta'u, buufata xiyyaarichatti hojiin balalii xiyyaaraa guutummaatti addaan citeera.

title: International condemnation of Houthis no longer enough, says senior Yemeni official
english: A top Yemeni official has called on the international community to move past verbal criticism of Houthi attacks on civilians and infrastructure. Abdullah al-Alimi Bawazir emphasized that global powers must now implement concrete actions to hold the group accountable and prevent further violence. He expressed strong support for Saudi Arabia’s role in regional security following recent claims of a Houthi strike near Riyadh.
amharic: የየመን ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣን አለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሲቪሎች እና መሰረተ ልማቶች ላይ የሚያደርሱትን ጥቃት በቃል ብቻ ከማውገዝ ባለፈ ተጨባጭ እርምጃ እንዲወስዱ ጠይቀዋል። አብደላህ አል-አሊሚ ባዋዚር እንዳሉት ዓለም አቀፍ አካላት ወንጀለኞችን ተጠያቂ ለማድረግ እና ጥቃቶችን ለመከላከል ጠንካራ መፍትሄዎችን መተግበር አለባቸው። ባለስልጣኑ በተለይም በሪያድ አቅራቢያ በተፈጸመው ጥቃት ሳዑዲ አረቢያን እንደሚደግፉ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Yaman, hawaasni addunyaa haleellaa gareen Huthis nagaa-bultootaafi bu'uuraalee misoomaa irratti gaggeessu arrabsuu qofa osoo hin taane, tarkaanfii qabatamaa fudhachuu akka qabu gaafataniiru. Abdullaah Al-Aliimii Baawaaziir akka jedhanitti, addunyaan garee kana itti gaafatamummaatti dhiyeessuufi haleellaa kanatti xumura godhuuf tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuu qaba. Hoggantichi haleellaa Riyaaditti dhihoo ta'ee raawwatamee hordofee, mootummaan Yaman mootummaa Sa'udii waliin dhaabbachuusaas ibseera.

title: Delhi braces for more protests as 'cockroach' group's leaders released
english: A court in Delhi has ordered the release of leaders from the Gen Z-led Cockroach Janta Party following their detention during a massive crackdown on planned protests. The group is advocating for electoral reforms and the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner ahead of upcoming state elections. Despite the release, the city remains on high alert with heavy security presence and restrictions to prevent further demonstrations.
amharic: የዴልሂ ፍርድ ቤት በታቀዱ የተቃውሞ ሰልፎች ወቅት በቁጥጥር ስር የዋሉትን የኮክሮች ጃንታ ፓርቲ መሪዎች እንዲፈቱ ትዕዛዝ ሰጥቷል። ቡድኑ መጪውን የክልል ምርጫ ተከትሎ የምርጫ ማሻሻያዎችን እንዲደረጉ እና ዋናው የምርጫ ኮሚሽነር ከስልጣናቸው እንዲነሱ በመጠየቅ ላይ ይገኛል። መሪዎቹ ቢፈቱም፣ ተጨማሪ ሰልፎችን ለመከላከል በከተማዋ ከፍተኛ የጸጥታ ጥበቃና እገዳዎች ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Mana murtii Dehlii hoogganoonni garee 'Cockroach Janta Party' jedhamu kanneen qabsoo karoorfame irratti hidhaman akka gadhiifaman ajajeera. Gareen kun filannoo naannoo dhufuuf jiruun dura fooyya'iinsa sirna filannoo fi murtaa'aan komishinii filannoo hojii irraa akka gaggeeffamu gaafataa jira. Hoogganoonni kunneen gadhiifamanis, magaalaan sun qabsoo itti aanu ittisuuf jecha humna nageenyaa fi uggura cimaa jala jirti.

title: Flash flood sweeps away buildings in Nepal
english: A sudden landslide in Nepal's Gorkha district triggered severe flash flooding along the Budhi Gandaki River on Sunday. The rushing water destroyed several homes and a bridge, leaving local residents terrified. Bystanders captured footage of the destruction from safe vantage points as the floodwaters swept through the area.
amharic: በኔፓል ጎርካ አውራጃ የተከሰተ የመሬት መንሸራተት በቡዲ ጋንዳኪ ወንዝ ላይ ከባድ የጎርፍ አደጋ አስከትሏል። ይህ ድንገተኛ ጎርፍ በርካታ መኖሪያ ቤቶችን እና ድልድዮችን ጠራርጎ በመውሰዱ በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ፍርሃት ፈጥሯል። በአካባቢው የነበሩ ሰዎች ጥፋቱን ከፍታ ቦታ ሆነው በቪዲዮ ቀርጸውታል።
oromo: Naannoo Gorkhaa kan biyya Neeppaalitti, lafti sigiguun isaa lagni Budhi Gaandaakii akka guutuufi lolaa cimaa akka uumu godheera. Lolaan kun manneen jireenyaa fi daandii cehuu hedduu barbadeessuun, namoota naannichaa rifachiiseera. Namoonni lolaa kana arguuf carrooman, miidhaa cimaa geessise kana iddoo mijataa irraa viidiyoon waraabaniiru.

title: Vinicius apologises for hair-pull red card but could miss El Clasico
english: Real Madrid forward Vinicius Jr. has apologized after receiving a red card for pulling an opponent's hair during a match against Villarreal. Although his team won, the goal he scored was overturned following a VAR review that identified his violent conduct. He now faces a potential suspension of up to three games, which could cause him to miss the highly anticipated El Clasico match against Barcelona.
amharic: የሪያል ማድሪዱ አጥቂ ቪኒሲየስ ጁኒየር በቪያሪያል ላይ በተደረገው ጨዋታ የተጋጣሚውን ተጫዋች ፀጉር በመሳቡ በቀይ ካርድ ከሜዳ ከተሰናበተ በኋላ ይቅርታ ጠይቋል። ምንም እንኳን ቡድኑ ቢያሸንፍም፣ ያስቆጠረው ግብ የቪዲዮ ረዳት ዳኛ (VAR) ጥሰቱን በማረጋገጡ ተሰርዟል። ተጫዋቹ እስከ ሶስት ጨዋታዎች ሊታገድ ስለሚችል፣ በሁለት ሳምንት ውስጥ ከባርሴሎና ጋር በሚደረገው ኤል ክላሲኮ ጨዋታ ላይ የመሰለፍ እድሉ አጠያያቂ ሆኗል።
oromo: Hirmaataan gubbaa Real Madrid Vinicius Jr. tapha Villarreal waliin taasisaniin mormituu isaa harkaan qabachudhaan kaardii diimaa erga fudhatee booda dhiifama gaafateera. Injifannoo gareen isaa argate iyyuu, gooliin inni galche gargaaraa teeknikaa (VAR) gocha hammeenyaa raawwachuu isaa mirkaneessuudhaan haqameera. Amma adabbiin tapha sadii isatti murteeffachuu danda'a, kunis tapha guddaa 'El Clasico' jedhamu kan Barcelona waliin taasifamu akka inni hin hirmaanne gochuu danda'a.
